text: Agent-Based Trust and Reputation Model in Smart IoT Environments states that open, dynamic IoT environments require collaboration with unknown entities that lack a proven track record. This supplies a distinct machine-to-machine setting in which missing performance history is operationally salient, extending Kaal's generative-exchange track-record mechanism. It does not test generative distributions or establish that reputation alone makes IoT collaboration trustworthy.
